disease_label_per_paper: Acute non-hemolytic febrile transfusion reaction after platelet concentrate
presentation_summary: A 68-year-old woman with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia developed an acute non-hemolytic transfusion reaction after platelet concentrate transfusion.
The reported reaction type was febrile with fever and chills.
The platelet component was from a male donor and had prestorage leukoreduction.

Patient serum had HLA class I and II antibodies; specificity included donor cognate A31 and AHG-LCT crossmatch was positive. These post-reaction immunohematology findings are confirmatory/non-ranking.
The article classifies this as a febrile ANHTR, not a TRALI/dyspnea or allergic reaction case.
